name: PCO Plan
description: Order of service from Planning Center Services, following ProPresenter live. Pick the service type at /modules/pco-plan/setup.html

appId.label: Planning Center Application ID (Personal Access Token)

accessToken.label: OAuth 2.0 access token (alternative to App ID + Secret)

serviceTypeId.label: Service type ID — browse folders and pick one at /modules/pco-plan/setup.html

planId.label: Pin a plan ID (blank = today's plan, else the next upcoming)

pollSeconds.label: Re-read the plan every N seconds

followProPresenter.label: Follow the ProPresenter module's live item to highlight the current plan item

showPlanHeader.label: Show plan title, date and service time

showStartTimes.label: Show scheduled start time of each item

showLength.label: Show planned length of each item

noteCategories.label: Only these note categories (comma-separated, blank = all)

showRuntime.label: Show live runtime (elapsed vs planned) when following ProPresenter

showLiveFooter.label: Show the ProPresenter match line at the bottom

dimCompleted.label: Dim items that are already done

autoScroll.label: Keep the current item in view
